definitions.gloss: middle blessing; a moderately good fortune (on an omikuji)
definitions.explanation: A fortune level on an {御神籤|おみくじ} (paper fortune drawn at shrines and temples), ranking below {大吉|だいきち} (great blessing) and above {小吉|しょうきち} (small blessing).

examples.japanese: おみくじで{中吉|ちゅうきち}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: I drew a middle blessing on the omikuji.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}で{引|ひ}いたおみくじは{中吉|ちゅうきち}だった。
examples.english: The fortune I drew on my New Year's shrine visit was a middle blessing.

examples.japanese: {大吉|だいきち}ではなかったが、{中吉|ちゅうきち}だったので{今年|ことし}はまあまあ{良|よ}い{年|とし}になりそうだ。
examples.english: It wasn't a great blessing, but it was a middle blessing, so this year looks like it will be a fairly good one.

notes:
A middling-good fortune drawn on an おみくじ. A common ranking, best to worst, is {大吉|だいきち} → {中吉|ちゅうきち} → {小吉|しょうきち} → {吉|きち} → {末吉|すえきち} → {凶|きょう}, though the exact order varies by shrine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中吉|ちゅうきち}が{出|で}る: to draw a middle blessing
- おみくじで{中吉|ちゅうきち}を{引|ひ}く: to pull a middle blessing on a fortune slip
